rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Your Family
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2004).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2004 as 'Your Family'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, light pink undertones. Moderate, sweet fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
